title: abutilon tomentosum
intro: Abutilon tomentosum, commonly known as Indian mallow or velvet leaf, is a plant species in the mallow family (Malvaceae) native to tropical Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits, including its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Abutilon tomentosum include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral effects, which make it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Abutilon tomentosum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
